title: JWT signature not verified (alg none accepted)
notes:
The API accepts JWTs with alg set to none. I took my own token, changed the header to alg none and the role from user to admin, removed the signature and GET /api/admin/users returned 200.
Original token used in testing: Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiIxMDAxIiwicm9sZSI6InVzZXIifQ.c2lnbmF0dXJlLWZvci1kZW1vLW9ubHk
